name: Axial Retailing Inc.
summary: Axial Retailing Inc. operates supermarkets in Japan. It also offers information processing and software development, cleaning, insurance agency, and manufacturing and printing services, as well as engages in the planning and production of various media, real estate management, and advertising agency activities. The company was formerly known as Harashin Narus Holdings Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Axial Retailing Inc. in October 2013. Axial Retailing Inc. was founded in 1907 and is headquartered in Nagaoka, Japan.
